# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For the SCGuardGolem mod, each git branch (mc/26.1, mc/1.21.11, mc/1.21.10, mc/1.21.8, mc/1.21.1, mc/1.20.4, mc/1.20.1) targets a different NeoForge version, Minecraft version, and SecurityCraft version. APIs may differ between branches — do not blindly copy files from mc/26.1 to older branches without checking for API compatibility.
